description.en: Plugins maintained by c3115644151 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: c3115644151 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护的插件。

description.en: Poll any external source (GitHub CI, issues, pull requests, mail, a local command) and hand new events to the next conversation step. Items have three states: pending, delivered and done, so the same event is not repeated forever. New events can wake one idle session so you do not have to ask again.
description.zh: 轮询任意外部来源（GitHub 的 CI、issue、PR，邮件，或一条本地命令），把新事件交给下一次对话步骤。条目有 pending / delivered / done 三个状态，同一条事件不会被无限重复提醒；新事件还可以唤醒一个空闲会话，不用你每次来问。
